eps.ov: Umaru Doma's life continues with an evening filled with video games... and no big brother in sight! Later, Umaru and her friends end up playing an intense game of soccer.
eps.oa: تمضي حياة «أومارو دوما» بأمسية تملؤها ألعاب الفيديو... ولا أثر لأخيها الأكبر! ثم تنتهي أومارو وصديقاتها إلى مباراة حامية في كرة القدم.

eps.ov: Taihei invites his coworkers over for dinner after work, and one of them, Alex, catches Umaru's attention. Why does this guy seem so familiar, and what's his deal with anime?
eps.oa: يدعو «تايهي» زملاءه في العمل إلى العشاء بعد الدوام، فيلفت أحدهم، «أليكس»، انتباه «أومارو». لماذا يبدو هذا الشاب مألوفاً إلى هذا الحد، وما قصته مع الأنمي؟

eps.ov: Alex interrupts Kirie and Umaru's afternoon to play a dating sim game. Kirie finds herself identifying with the main character. Later, Umaru discovers an addictive new game.
eps.oa: يقطع «أليكس» على «كيري» و«أومارو» عصرهما ليلعب لعبة محاكاة مواعدة. فتجد كيري نفسها تتماهى مع الشخصية الرئيسية. ثم تكتشف أومارو لعبة جديدة تأسرها.

eps.t: A Party with the Whole Gang
eps.ov: Umaru spends Christmas evening with her friends, and Sylphyn remembers a childhood Christmas wish. On New Year's morning, Umaru receives a suspicious gift from Taihei.
eps.oa: تقضي «أومارو» مساء عيد الميلاد مع صديقاتها، وتتذكر «سيلفين» أمنية لعيد الميلاد من طفولتها. وفي صباح رأس السنة تتلقى أومارو هدية مريبة من «تايهي».

eps.ov: Taihei leaves for a business trip with his co-workers. While his boss Kanau thinks of a way to spend time with him, Taihei has his hands full with a vacation-happy stowaway.
eps.oa: يغادر «تايهي» في رحلة عمل مع زملائه. وبينما تفكر رئيسته «كاناو» في طريقة تقضي بها الوقت معه، تشغله متسللة مولعة بالعطلات.

eps.ov: While visiting Umaru, Kirie’s secret aspiration is found out! Will Umaru’s encouragement be enough to help Kirie overcome her self-doubt?
eps.oa: في أثناء زيارة «أومارو» ينكشف طموح «كيري» السري! فهل يكفي تشجيع أومارو ليعين كيري على تجاوز شكها في نفسها؟

eps.ov: Umaru and the girls head out to spend a fun day at the amusement park, but Kirie is having a few struggles. Will the day end up a total disaster?
Umaru and the gang have a spontaneous get-together, but when things don't go as expected, hilarity ensues.
After Bomba gives Taihei one of his old cameras, Taihei spends sometime reconnecting with Umaru. Later, the tension between Hikari and Umaru increases.
Sylphin invites UMR over to her house, where a slight misunderstanding leads to some awkwardness. Later on, Umaru seems to have found a weakness in Hikari’s armor.
Kirie devises a new plan to bring Ebina and Taihei closer. However, Taihei might have a couple to many little sisters fighting for his attention already.
It's the end of the year, and everyone is figuring out what Christmas gifts to get their loved ones. Can Umaru and the others find the perfect presents?
